blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) has tapped the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) to investigate the finances linked to the 521-kilogram shabu (methamphetamine) shipment intercepted in Laos, amid indications that some Philippine officials may be involved. At a press conference on Wednesday, PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co said the agency met with the AMLC and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) on Tuesday regarding the ongoing investigation into the shipment of illegal drugs worth P3.5 billion. “We are now in the process of evaluating all the evidence that we have compiled for the eventual joint transmittal […]...
